Neither u nor s is detached. Consequently the product includes the derivative of s and recovers the raw-fusion derivative, rather than treating its norm as a constant. The calculation stays FP32 under disabled autocast.

The synthetic CPU fixture calls the actual override and reconstructs the existing M/F/I formula independently; it compares raw values, normalized values and derivatives with respect to modality, relation-frequency, gates, residual scales and interaction weights.
